description.value: CuppaJoe Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver specialty coffee roaster with over 25 years of experience crafting small-batch, freshly roasted beans using traditional drum roasters and third-wave sourcing principles. The East Kent Avenue location is the company's roasting plant and head office, open to visitors for purchasing premium coffee beans and brewing supplies. They also operate separate retail cafe locations in Burnaby, making this stop primarily a beans-and-supplies destination rather than a sit-down coffee bar.

address.value: 104-350 East Kent Ave. South, Vancouver, BC V5X 4N6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the phone number (604-709-4563) and address (104-350 East Kent Ave. South, Vancouver, BC V5X 4N6) matching OSM tags. The East Kent location is described as a 'Roasting Plant & Head Office' where visitors can purchase beans and supplies, while a full coffee bar experience is noted at their separate Burnaby Madison Centre location. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Cuppa Joe Coffee Roasters' (two words) but the website consistently uses 'CuppaJoe Coffee Roasters' (one word) — minor name discrepancy.

OSM tags this as amenity=cafe, but the East Kent location is primarily a roasting plant and head office, not a traditional cafe with barista service. Retail bean/supply sales are available but walk-in coffee bar service is not confirmed at this address.
Full coffee bar experience is explicitly noted only at the separate Burnaby Madison Centre location, not at the East Kent roasting plant.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a confirmed physical location open to the public for purchasing coffee beans and supplies. Site is live with a 2026 copyright.
